Sweeten with the sugar and serve with a drift of evaporated milk.

steps.text: Soak the peas, then rub off and winnow the skins before blending them with the onion, scotch bonnet, and ginger into a stiff batter.
Whip the batter briefly with a spoon so it lightens.
Fry rounded spoonfuls in deep oil until each fritter turns deep gold and puffs slightly; drain on a rack.
